title: Species, Profession, Prestige & Progression Coverage
objective: Map retained species, profession, prestige and progression concepts to exact owners/dispositions, preserving explicit source gaps and the CAB species/innate ownership boundary without inventing missing rules.
boundaries: Species/innate acquisition remains evidence-driven and mixed-source classification stays in CAB-22 rather than being guessed.
Profession/crafting progression keeps owning prerequisites and learning requirements; XP does not bypass them.
Prestige entry may begin at Tier 3 only under explicit requirements and governed access semantics; no T1/T2 filler or back-pay is invented.
Missing progression identity, prerequisite, acquisition and tier facts remain CAB-22 repair items.
SGC-03C remains unauthorized until its own governed start.
